assertions.subject: Pulmonary Atresia with Ventricular Septal Defect
assertions.quote: Lesions frequently showing MAPCAs in their pathology are called "pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect."

assertions.subject: Pulmonary Atresia with Ventricular Septal Defect
assertions.quote: This low oxygen level drives the nonregression of aortopulmonary collateral vessels.

assertions.subject: Pulmonary Atresia with Ventricular Septal Defect
assertions.quote: Several pathophysiological mechanisms have been proposed, such as monosomy 22q11, hypoxemia, and abnormal pulmonary blood pressure.

assertions.subject: Tetralogy of Fallot (TOF) with pulmonary atresia (TOF/PA)
assertions.quote: Lesions frequently showing MAPCAs in their pathology are called "pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect." However, it is more descriptive to consider them as tetralogy of Fallot (TOF) with pulmonary atresia (TOF/PA).

assertions.subject: TOF/PA
assertions.quote: Neonates can develop hypoxic symptoms if the PDA closes or if the MAPCAs are narrow or stenosed in severe cases.
